parsed.explanation: The quoted line is verbatim: Lemma 2's entire proof is "This follows by a descent on the weight w (standard; details omitted)." Lemma 2 is precisely the large-prime-erasure/finiteness content of L6.2 — it is the only place where the greedy dynamics and the bound a_1 constrain which primes can appear, and everything downstream (terminal members have |D| <= a_1, P finite, C finite, L defined) rests on it. Lemma 1 (sunflower) is purely combinatorial and does not supply it; self-duality (1) and (2) do not either, since a pairwise intersecting antichain can be infinite. No other passage carries out the descent, so L6.2 is unestablished; the repair requires writing the omitted lemma.
